reviews.title: Terrible service
reviews.text: I was recommended this service by a friend. Ordered my badge with a month to spare as I didn’t want to pay for months I didn’t need. My badge didn’t ship until a day before we were due to leave. So no way I will get it in time. And you only have 30 days to ship it back to cancel it. No way to cancel through the app or get my money back… and I will be charged for the extra month. What a joke. Don’t use them. You will be paying for months of subscriptions you don’t use. I would give 0 stars if I could.

reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.text:
Radio silence from Bip&Go over many messages. My account has been frozen because they keep failing to collect payment. Definitely look at alternatives. The app is janky and the tag itself doesn’t work at some gates in France, leaving you in weird situations where you’re stuck between a gate zone without a paper ticket.

Do not use this company.
